name: Triad — Epoch‑Ignition Temporal‑Window Geometry
summary: Defines the temporal‑window geometry of epoch‑ignition behavior, including ignition‑epoch window formation, ignition‑epoch window propagation geometry, ignition‑epoch window stabilization surfaces, and multi‑layer ignition‑epoch window binding.
purpose: Provide the temporal‑window geometry used by Scanner, O.H.S.H.I.T., and Atlas to shape epoch‑ignition windows, propagate ignition‑epoch window behavior across temporal epochs, stabilize window fronts, and bind epoch‑level temporal‑window coherence across the Triad pipeline.
